Follow-up to #51. CodeRabbit's review of 8b2c8d8 (the last fix round, after 38 commits) left five non-blocking findings. They are tracked here so #51 can land. Each fix needs a test that fails on revert.

Priority order:
1. [src/portable.ts:353](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-memory/pull/51#discussion_r4545166743): Quick win. **Production code, fix first:** a `tags` array longer than the engine's argument limit throws a `RangeError` during import, because the tags are spread into `push(...)`. Use a loop, and add a test with a very large tag array.
2. [test/portable.test.ts:352](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-memory/pull/51#discussion_r4545166757): Heavy lift. This overlaps #61, which makes the contention test deterministic with explicit barriers. Re-check after #61 merges, and close this point if #61 covers it.
3. [test/review-boundaries.test.ts:167](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-memory/pull/51#discussion_r4545166766): Maintainability & Code Quality.
4. [test/review-boundaries.test.ts:213](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-memory/pull/51#discussion_r4545166771): Maintainability & Code Quality.
5. [test/sdk-structured-secret.test.ts:23](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-memory/pull/51#discussion_r4545166776): Security & Privacy. **Security test gap:** `JSON.stringify(error)` omits the non-enumerable `message`, so the test cannot see a credential leaked into the refusal text. Assert on `error.message` and on `String(error)`.
Follow-up to #51: tag spread limit, refusal-message secret check and three test-precision findings
